content.short: DCAP is an investment advisor for Web3-related assets.
content.description: DCAP serves as an investment advisor focused on Web3-related assets and opportunities. The firm remains deeply embedded in the blockchain ecosystem and is driven by a belief in the transformative potential of digital assets and decentralized technologies. By staying close to ongoing developments in networks, protocols, and the broader Web3 landscape, DCAP seeks to identify and engage with promising ventures and opportunities at the intersection of finance and decentralization.
